coupling.past: identical for the four arms: same scene seed, same executed action prefix (prefix replay), same policy history and queue
coupling.continue_alt_noise: restored and verified like every arm; then only Runtime.repeat is set to r + 4. No force, no clear, no extra inference, no extra action. Until the old queue is used up it must be the same rollout as continue (commands, simulator state, observation returned by the environment); a block that violates this is an error, not data
coupling.refresh_and_retreat: unchanged from Stage 2A: physical-step noise key r; calls at other steps than Continue draw other noise by design
coupling.reference: pairs are joined on (scene, checkpoint, block_repeat_id) only

noise.seed_rule: seed_for(scene, physical_step_of_the_call, policy_noise_repeat_id, 'dp'), set immediately before each Agent.get_action inside torch.random.fork_rng (unchanged code path; covers the initial noise and the reverse-diffusion draws of that call)
noise.caveat: different integer seeds give another pseudo-random realisation; this is not a proof of statistical independence. C0 and C1 may well have the same outcome; no check requires them to differ.
